from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from fontTools.pens.svgPathPen import SVGPathPen
from fontTools.pens.boundsPen import BoundsPen
f=TTFont("$A/fonts/InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf")
print("features:", sorted({fr.FeatureTag for fr in f['GSUB'].table.FeatureList.FeatureRecord}))
gs=f.getGlyphSet(); cmap=f.getBestCmap(); hmtx=f['hmtx']
text="Collega"; x=0; paths=[]; 
# kerning via GPOS ignored; small tracking -2% (spec display)
upm=f['head'].unitsPerEm; track=-0.02*upm
xmin=ymin=1e9; xmax=ymax=-1e9
for ch in text:
    g=cmap[ord(ch)]; pen=SVGPathPen(gs); 
    from fontTools.pens.transformPen import TransformPen
    tp=TransformPen(pen,(1,0,0,-1,x,0)); gs[g].draw(tp); paths.append(pen.getCommands())
    bp=BoundsPen(gs); gs[g].draw(bp)
    if bp.bounds:
        b=bp.bounds; xmin=min(xmin,x+b[0]); xmax=max(xmax,x+b[2]); ymin=min(ymin,-b[3]); ymax=max(ymax,-b[1])
    x+=hmtx[g][0]+track
w=xmax-xmin; h=ymax-ymin
svg=f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="{xmin:.0f} {ymin:.0f} {w:.0f} {h:.0f}" width="{w/upm*100:.1f}" height="{h/upm*100:.1f}"><title>Collega</title><path fill="#0E5E63" d="{" ".join(paths)}"/></svg>'
import os; os.makedirs("$A/brand", exist_ok=True)
open("$A/brand/wordmark.svg","w").write(svg)
print(len(svg), w, h)
EOF
